venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH came in -54.9% vs target on Sunday ($1,902 vs $4,216) — a quiet post-anniversary night.** Food $113. Comps $109 (5.7%) — Industry Night plus one manager tasting comp tab. 64 guests / $29.71 GCA. **'Nice Sunday night — consistent flow of guests throughout the evening.'** Around 6:30pm a group of ~15-20 came in to celebrate a birthday; they told Kala they had a great time and were excited to come back. Good mix of guests: industry folks, a handful of new neighbors arriving separately, drink nerds, and novice drinkers exploring new options — 'great night all around.' **Kitchen**: 'Held it down!' **Maintenance**: kitchen door, walk-in fridge door (recurring). No incident, no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: ran into a friend from years ago who brought in a handful of industry friends. MOD/Chef: KE, KC. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR beat target +16.1% ($11,437.74 vs $9,853.11) on Sunday — no events, all restaurant.** Segments: DC/AM $2,016.26, D&C PM $9,421.48, Garden/6A $3,730.88. Total food $2,673.40. No event sales. Comps $335.16 (2.93%). 168 guests (Tock) / $68.08 GCA. **DC/AM (Felix)**: 'Sweet, busy day with guest Odessa — absolutely killed it on the bar; a couple IRDs plus a nice cocktail pop evened out the afternoon.' **D&C PM (Carey)**: 'Very nice Sunday — chill on the floor but the Garden had great flow most of the night; cut opener early and ran with no host, but with Maggie H. and myself on the floor it was a smooth evening.' **Garden/6A (Kim)**: 'Pretty chill, lots of friends and hotel guests coming through.' **Kitchen (Nate)**: 'Slow night with a pop at the end; chill vibes on the line and fire family meal from Avery.' No incident, no no-shows charged, break make-up complete. **Highlight**: 'Watching Maggie H. become comfortable in this massive space — a breath of fresh air.' MOD: Maggie H. (AM) / Carey (PM). Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV came in -23.3% vs target on Sunday ($3,836 vs $5,000).** Food $429 + Bev $3,381 + Retail $26; net (excl/incl events) $3,836. 110 guests (Sevenrooms) / $34.87 GCA. Comps $216.92 (incl. 6 investor cocktails). **'After a brutal open (only 15 covers before 7:15) that gave time for advance side work, the room suddenly flourished into a full house'** — Seattle techies, Philly parents, Athens/REM bartenders, and a New Orleans couple the team half-convinced to move to NYC. Composition: 6 solos, 2 large parties (quick post-dinner space-fillers), 6 investor cocktails. **Door**: 'Slow open, then built momentum to a brief waitlist around 10pm; all outside parties came in. Slowed at 11, but a few late industry stragglers helped.' **Kitchen**: noted. **Glassware**: 3 DOF, 1 footed pilsner. No no-shows charged. Menu count 16. Top sellers: First Time Listener, Turtle Power, Material Control. MOD/Chef: Seth & Alejandro. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA came in -4.6% vs target on Sunday ($5,040 vs $5,282) — a near-miss.** All Marquee ($5,040); Standing Room closed ($0). Food $997. Comps $251 (industry, investors, spill, DNL). 127 guests / $39.69 GCA (calculated; form-entered GCA of $90 is a per-check figure / entry error, consistent with LA's recurring pattern). **'A very steady Sunday night.'** Opened with 44 covers and got a decent push right after doors; lots of regulars stopped by to check out the new menu with strong feedback. Room filled early, built a decent waitlist at one point but seated everyone, and stayed full through a strong last call — 'a successful first week of the menu.' **Kitchen**: 'Nice work!' **Maintenance**: beer taps acting up. No incident. No-shows charged. **Highlight**: 'When Jorge made us quesadillas at the end of the night.' MOD/Chef: Joe + Josh. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Overcast and gloomy with heavy showers in the evening
venues.narrative: **MG beat target +11.1% ($7,779 vs $7,000) on Sunday — a calm reset after grad/wedding weekend.** Segments: MB Morning $3,841 (102 covers), MB Evening $3,398 (72 covers), Sun Club $72, Hot Eye $1,230. Food $3,052. No event sales. Comps $307. 174 MB OpenTable guests / $44.71 GCA. **Morning (Sam & Shannon)**: 'Very consistent sales through midmorning into early afternoon at a far more reasonable pace than the rest of the weekend; despite everyone running on E from the Thursday-Saturday mayhem, brunch and lunch were smooth — a breath of fresh air.' **Evening (James & Marcus)**: 'Back to normal — a quiet, relaxing Sunday; staffed heavily but made cuts when the rain hit and most reservations cancelled. Decent walk-ins still made it a solid night.' **Sun Club**: 'Slow due to weather; began shutting down ~3pm, fully closed by 4:10.' **Hot Eye**: 'Welcome slow start let us get a head start on inventory and reset (Elizabeth crushed it); large groups ~9pm, then slow-but-steady with lots of industry. Nice to decompress with co-workers after the weekend.' **Kitchen**: 'Excellent — no food comped, sent back, or delayed.' No incident. **Maintenance**: Hot Eye door hinge hanging off; Hot Eye carbonation faucets stopped pouring water (spewing air). **Highlight**: 'Co-workers hanging in Hot Eye after an exhausting weekend — felt good to sit together and decompress.' Morning MOD: Sam & Shannon / Evening MOD: James & Marcus. Entered by Sam B.
